# MineDeck

> MineDeck 是 Windows 上的我的世界（Minecraft Java 版）一键开服工具：单文件 exe，自动下载 Java 和服务端，图形界面管理服务器，整合包一键导入，内置樱花穿透、OpenFrp 内网穿透；可选接入自己的 AI Key，提供 AI 开服助手、游戏内 AI、AI 伙伴，以及音乐共享。MineDeck is a one-click Minecraft (Java Edition) server launcher for Windows. Its interface is Chinese only for now. MIT licensed.

- Platform: Windows 10 / 11 (Windows 11 recommended: music sharing can record a single program there).
- Distribution: a single `MineDeck.exe` (about 13 MB, no installer, no dependencies), downloaded from GitHub Releases. Current version: 2.9.0-beta.1 (beta).
- Server software: Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Leaves, Folia, Fabric, NeoForge, Forge, Mohist, Banner, Velocity, Waterfall; Minecraft 1.12.2 to the latest release. Modrinth (`.mrpack`) and CurseForge (zip) modpacks can be imported.
- Java: picked from Mojang's version metadata and downloaded as a portable runtime; nothing to install by hand.
- Playing with friends elsewhere: built-in frp tunnels (SakuraFrp, OpenFrp, self-hosted frps).
- Optional AI (your own API key; OpenAI-compatible or Claude protocol): an in-app assistant that reads logs and configs and only changes things after you confirm; in-game `@AI` chat; AI companions built on PlayerEngine (NeoForge 1.21.1, Forge 1.20.1). Music sharing streams the host's music player through Simple Voice Chat. Without configuration MineDeck connects to no AI service.
